The giant tree creature sinks down in place: its root legs buckle, it slumps down onto its knees and leans back, its branch arms drooping to the ground, its head hanging; it stays in the middle and does not fall out of view.
The giant tree creature raises both branch arms up high above its head, twig fingers spread, leans back and opens its mouth wide as if roaring, then holds that pose. Arms stay solid and sharp.
